US Court Decision Looms Over Adani Group's Legal Case

A legal case involving the Adani Group in the United States is approaching a potential resolution. Lawyers have indicated that a judge's approval is pending regarding the conclusion of the lawsuit, which was filed by the US Department of Justice. The outcome could significantly impact the Adani Group's standing.
